entries.zh: 阻骂；用恶语羞辱责骂人
entries.en: to shame with insults; to obstruct and revile someone
entries.notes: 西语残句 en malo pa la coßig（pa 当为 para 缩写、coßig 难解）需推断展开，义项由 avergoncar 与汉字「阻骂」合定。

entries.zh: 失礼于人；亏待人而使人蒙羞
entries.en: to wrong or fail a person, to fall short toward others; to shame

entries.zh: 阻挠人行事，使其无意作为；拦阻人所欲为
entries.en: to discourage and hinder someone from what he intends to do; to thwart
entries.notes: 西语 lo que quiere hacer（阻人所愿）与汉字「無意」（非本意/失却意愿）侧重不合，释义取「阻挠人」为主。

entries.en: to be deeply ashamed, abashed
entries.notes: 西语残句 de ne cinir 未解；汉字「欺甚」带[疑:歁甚]标记，义项仅由 avergonzarse 定「羞惭」。

entries.zh: 当众羞辱他，使他在人前难堪
entries.en: to shame someone before others, in public
entries.notes: 首字「翕」带[疑:歙衆]标记且与羞辱义未安；释义由西语 delante de otros 与「眾」（众人）定为当众羞辱。

entries.en: shame; to be ashamed
entries.notes: 西语残句 tengo muy fuanda 难解；汉字带[疑:盖]标记，义项由「羞」与 avergoncar 定。

entries.en: to be ashamed; ashamed countenance
shame, disgrace; to feel ashamed
shame, embarrassment; to feel ashamed
humiliation; to shame, to be insulted
to be ashamed and to shame another; disgrace
entries.notes: 汉字「失接」疑有讹（音写 sét chiàp），M 栏内嵌西语 vergonça（羞耻）；义项由 avergonzarse y avergonzar 定两义。

entries.en: to disgrace, bring dishonor upon
to feel shame, be embarrassed
entries.notes: 汉字「八妬」带[疑:姖]标记且与音写 pé-tî 难对应通行词形，义项仅依西语 avergoncarse 定「羞惭」。

entries.zh: 畏人鄙夷而羞惭；羞于见鄙
entries.en: to be ashamed at being despised; to dread contempt
entries.notes: 西语 por leuitar 未解；汉字「偎鄙」带[疑:畏鄙]，以「畏鄙」（畏人鄙薄）与 avergoncarse 合定。

entries.zh: 查究开豁；勘验探察、询问
entries.en: to find out, pry into, examine, inquire
entries.notes: 西语 fuigar 非通行词形（或为 fisgar「窥探」之讹），且官话栏双音节 cō hēo 与单字「豁」不合；义项由 averiguar/examinar/preguntar 定。

entries.en: to ascertain and decide conclusively
to interrogate; to try a case judicially
to interrogate and examine, try a case
to investigate, look into thoroughly
to get to the bottom of, investigate to the very end
to judge, decide (a case)
to cross-question, interrogate closely
to inquire into a matter by asking; to interrogate
to inspect, survey, examine on site
to interrogate officially, examine as in a visitation
